analogy.rationale: RNA polymerase inhibition blocks transcription, producing a transcriptional signature that overlaps with other inhibitors of nucleic acid synthesis and with downstream stress programs; however, the class annotation includes many off-target pharmacokinetic genes (SLCO, CYP, NR1I2), so the expected response is only moderate.
